snippets.snippet: 3. No temporary residential unit shall be stored or parked, if not used for residential purposes, but for business purposes, on any private parcels within the Village. 4. The wheels or any similar transporting devices of any temporary residential unit shall not be removed, nor shall said temporary residential unit be attached to the ground, in an attempt to redefine the temporary residential unit as a permanent residential unit. 5. No temporary residential unit, if owned by the owner of the property, shall be parked or stored upon the owner’s property unless actively used solely, for recreational purposes by the owner or occupant of the premises outside of the Village. 6. ORDINANCE NO. 12-5 AN ORDINANCE PROHIBITING THE PARKING AND STORAGE OF FIFTH WHEEL TRAILERS, MOBILE HOMES, RECREATIONAL VEHICLES, MOTOR HOMES, TRUCK CAMPERS, PARK TRAILERS, TRAVEL TRAILERS AND OTHER TEMPORARY RESIDENTIAL UNITS WITHIN THE VILLAGE OF MORRISTOWN, OHIO, AND DECLARING AN EMERGENCY SECTION I WHEREAS, the Village of Morristown is listed on the National Register of Historic Places and is basically a peaceful and quiet residential community that does support economic development. WHEREAS, the Village of Morristown is located in Belmont County, Ohio, which county is subject to economic growth, stimulated by the oil and gas industry.
